and is attacking our lands again.

extremely distorted and fragile.
m400575.この子が急に茶目っ気を発揮したみたいで、\n塔を全部融合させるっていう悪戯をした:
It seems this one suddenly felt mischievous and
played a prank by fusing all the towers together.
m400575.これで塔は元に戻るのですか？: Will the tower revert to its original state now?
m400575.そういうことなので王子君。\n塔を解体し、元に戻すのに協力してもらえませんか？: So, Prince. Could you help us dismantle the structure and restore it to its original state?
m400575.その代わり、現時点での最上階に\n全戦力が集結しているみたいですが……。: However, it appears all their forces have gathered on the topmost floor…
m400575.そもそも設計思想の異なる施設同士だったんですから、\n全部混ざっちゃった以上、今: Besides, they were designed with completely different philosophies to begin with. Now that everything is blended together, I doubt they can be used for military training the way they were before.
m400575.それで作戦についてですが、\nかなりの数の敵と戦うことが予想されるため、\n『大: As for the strategy, we expect to face a considerable number of enemies, so I propose issuing a "Grand Subjugation Mission."
m400575.それに、塔が合体した原因も分かりましたから。: Besides, we've figured out what caused the towers to merge.
m400575.それは……あなたが連れている幽霊、ですか？: That is……the ghost you're carrying around, isn't it?
m400575.それは、なにか根拠があってのことですか？: Is there some basis for that?
m400575.それを踏まえて、指揮を頼むぞ、王子！: With that in mind, I'm leaving the command to you, Prince!
m400575.そんなこと言ってもしょうがないじゃないですか！\n現に合体しちゃったんですから！: Saying that doesn't change anything! They're already combined!
m400575.そんな目で私を見ないでくださいよ……。: Please stop looking at me like that…
m400575.そんな脆弱な塔を崩れないように維持しているのが、\nあの守護者だと思われるからで:
I believe that Guardian is what's keeping such a
vulnerable tower from collapsing.
m400575.つまり、各塔にあった条件などは、\n一切適用されないということです。:
That means none of the conditions that applied to the individual towers
will be in effect.
m400575.つまりあの守護者さえ倒せば、塔は自然と元通りになって、\nこの事件は全部まるっと:
So if we defeat that Guardian, the tower will naturally return to normal,
and this whole incident will be resolved in one go, is that right?
m400575.つまり部隊を展開するためには、『援軍要請』を持つ者や、\nワルキューレたちを編成: In other words, to deploy our units, we'll need to include those who can issue "Reinforcement Requests," as well as the Valkyries.
m400575.ていうか塔で働いてた私はどうすればいいんですかー！？: Wait, what am I supposed to do? I worked in the towers!
m400575.でしたら、私たちはもう戻りましょうか。: In that case, we should head back.
m400575.となると、あれを優先して狙うほうが良さそうだな。: If that's the case, we should probably prioritize targeting it.
m400575.とりあえず後の処理は、ソラス様とニミュエ様、\nそれからアンブローズ様にお任せす: For now, I'll leave the aftermath to Solais, Nimue, and Ambrose.
m400575.どうしてそんなことになったのかはともかく、\n各塔が混ざるとなにか不都合があるん: Setting aside how this happened, is there any downside to the towers being mixed together?
m400575.どうやら、全部解決したみたいですね。: It seems everything has been resolved.
m400575.どんな手違いがあったら、\nあんな巨大な建造物が一つに融合するんですか……？: What kind of mistake causes massive structures like those to merge into one…?
m400575.なにか、特別強そうな守護者がいませんか……？: Is there a Guardian that looks particularly strong……?
m400575.なるほど！ アンブローズ様は、\nニミュエ様を手伝いたいと思っているものの、\n: I see! So Ambrose wants to help Nimue, but feels awkward about it because he's been absent for a thousand years!
m400575.なんで一つになっちゃったのかとか、\nそもそも塔は今どういう状態なのかとか、\n: We need to properly figure out why they merged in the first place, and what state the towers are currently in.
m400575.はい、どうやら今回の事件の犯人は、\nこの子だったみたいです。:
Yes, it appears the culprit behind this incident was
this one.
m400575.はい、ソラス様と私で事足りると思いますー。\nなのでアンブローズ様は帰ってもらっ: Yes, I think Solais and I can manage. So you may head home, Ambrose.
m400575.ひんっ！？\nそんなはっきり言わないでくださいよぉ！？: Hmph!? Don't say things so bluntly!
m400575.まぁ、可能性があるっていうか、\nほぼ確実にそうなると思いますよ。: Well, "a chance" is putting it mildly. I'm almost certain that's what will happen.
m400575.まったくもってそのとおりですよー！\nだから私たちで、塔を元に戻してあげましょう:
You're absolutely right!
So let us restore the towers to how they were!!
m400575.もう出てくる気配もありませんし、\n諸々の作業に集中できそうです。: There's no sign of any more coming, so we can focus on the work at hand.
m400575.やったぁ！\nこれでまた王子さまたちに挑んでもらえますね！:
Yaaay!
Now you can challenge us again, Prince and the others!
m400575.ライフが０になっても倒した敵の数は\nばっちりカウントされるので、\n諦めず敵に:
Even if your Life drops to zero, the enemies you defeat will still be counted.
So don't give up—keep standing your ground against them.
m400575.一応反省してるみたいですし、\n私の方からも叱っておくので、\n許してもらえない:
It looks like it's regretting it now, so
I'll give it a scolding on my end too.
Could you please forgive it……?
m400575.一応点検はしないといけませんが、\nすぐに各塔を利用できる状態にはしておくので、:
We'll need to run some inspections, but
we'll get each tower back into a usable state right away,
so please rest assured.
m400575.仕事に誇りを持ちすぎていますねぇ……。: They take far too much pride in their work…
m400575.仕事熱心なのは誇らしいことですが、\n塔の皆さんを助ける邪魔をされるのは困ります:
Their dedication to duty is admirable, but
it's a nuisance when it gets in the way of helping the tower's residents.
m400575.同じくですね。\nおそらくは塔が混ざり合った際に生まれた、\n新しい守護者なので:
Same here.
It's likely a new Guardian born when the towers merged.
m400575.塔たちのそれぞれの部品が、\n元ある場所に戻っていく感じがしますし、\nもう大丈:
It feels like the components of each tower are
returning to their original places, so I think we're safe now.
m400575.塔たちを元に戻すために、\n同僚のみんなには眠ってもらいますよー！！: To restore the towers to normal, I'll put my colleagues to sleep!!
m400575.塔の守護者たちは、こちらと戦うつもりのようだな。: The tower's Guardians appear intent on fighting us.
m400575.大ありですよー！\nあれらは訓練施設でもあるんですから！: A huge one! Those are training facilities, after all!
m400575.少し中を覗いてみましたけど、\nそれぞれの塔の機構が干渉し合ってるらしく、\n現: I took a quick peek inside, and it looks like the mechanisms of each tower are interfering with one another, so nothing is operating normally right now!
m400575.当然スコアだとかもなくなっているので、\nこれから挑む塔は、訓練施設ではなく、\:
Naturally, scores and such are gone too.
So please think of the tower we're about to enter not as a training facility,
but simply as a building…
m400575.手伝いは、もういらない感じですかぁ？: Is there no more need for my help?
m400575.最後に、塔は混ざり合った影響で、\nそれぞれにあった特性が失われています。:
Finally, due to the effects of the merger,
the tower has lost its individual characteristics.
m400575.混ざった塔から得られるものはほとんどないので、\n敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド:
There is very little to gain from the merged tower.
Please be aware that defeating enemies will not yield any EXP or Gold.
m400575.温まってきたみたいですし、そろそろ向かうとしましょうか。: It seems everyone's spirits are rising. Let's head over then.
m400575.王子、此度の討伐お疲れ様でした！: Prince, well done on this subjugation!
m400575.目標は、塔の調査及び解体を妨害する敵を、\n可能な限り減らすことです。\nとにか:
The objective is to reduce, as much as possible, the number of enemies interfering with the investigation and dismantling of the tower.
Please focus entirely on defeating them!
m400575.相当深刻な不具合が起きているようですね。: It seems a rather serious malfunction is occurring.
m400575.私が占星術師で、英傑の塔にずっといたから。\n……というのは根拠として不十分です: I'm an astrologer who has been stationed in the Tower of Heroes all this time. ……Is that not sufficient proof?
m400575.私たちの侵入を感知して、\n塔が大量の守護者を出してくる可能性がありますので。: There's a chance the tower will detect our intrusion and deploy a large number of Guardians.
m400575.私とニミュエちゃんで、\nそれぞれの塔を点検していたんですが、\nちょーっとだけ: Solais and I were inspecting our respective towers, but it seems we made a little… mistake.
m400575.私は二本ほど塔を設計していますが、\n製作者の言うことも聞けない感じですかー？: I've designed a couple of towers myself, but is this what it's like when even the creators can't get a word in?
m400575.統帥の塔にあった特定の人だけ有利に戦える機能や、\n悪霊の塔にあった入場制限はな:
It seems the feature in the Command Tower that favored specific individuals,
as well as the entry restrictions in the Wraith Tower, have vanished.
m400575.自分たちが試練を与える者という認識だけは、\n混ざり合っても変わらなかったみたい:
It seems the notion that they are the ones who bestow trials upon others
has remained unchanged, even after the merger.
m400575.英傑の塔、統帥の塔、悪霊の塔の三つの塔が、\nなんでか一つに融合しちゃったんです: The Tower of Heroes, the Tower of Command, and the Tower of Wraiths have somehow fused into a single structure…
m400575.融合した際の機構の欠陥で生まれたようなものですから、\n長期間稼働することはでき:
It seems it was born from a flaw in the mechanism during the fusion,
so it apparently couldn't operate for a long period.
m400575.行き場を失った者もいるようですね……。: It seems some of us have lost our place…
m400575.製作者の知らない敵が出てくるのは、\n怖いような、面白いような……。:
Facing an enemy the creators don't know about is
a bit scary, but also kind of exciting……
m400575.襲いかかってくるみたいだから対応するが、\nその新しい守護者とやらは倒しても構わ:
It looks like it's about to lunge at us, so we'll deal with it, but
is it all right if we take down that new Guardian?
m400575.要するに、戦闘は避けられないということですか。: So, in short, combat is unavoidable.
m400575.解体……の前に調査をするんだったか。: We need to investigate before we start dismantling…
m400575.言いたいことがあるなら、\n本人にはっきり伝えるべきだと思いますが。: If you have something to say, you should just say it to her directly.

m500434.――勝った後の相談じゃなくて、\n負けた後の相談でもしておくべきだと思うよ。: I think we should have a talk about what to do if we lose, not just if we win.
m500434.――報告は以上だ。\n鬼たちに復活する様子はないし、\nソハヤノツルギも、完全に:
――That concludes the report.
The demons show no signs of reviving,
and Sohayano Tsurugi appears to be completely shattered.
m500434.――見事、なり……鬼狩りの、英雄、よ……。: ...Impressive... You are truly the hero of the demon hunters...
m500434.――貴様と手を組む日が来るとはなァ。: ――To think the day would come when I'd join hands with you.
m500434.…………何が、馬鹿娘、だ。酒呑よ。: ……What a foolish girl, huh. Wine Cellar Boy.
m500434.……ありがとう。\nこれからも、あては一緒に戦うから。\nずっと、ずーっとね！:
……Thank you.
From now on, I'll be fighting by your side.
For a long, long time!
m500434.……ぐふぅッ……クソッ……。\nこの酒呑童子が……ここで、終わりか……。:
...Ugh... Damn it...
Is this... where Wine Cellar Boy's story ends...?
m500434.……これは、骨が折れそうだな。: ...This is going to be a tough fight.
m500434.「大嶽丸」と「酒呑童子」が手を組みやがった！！: "Otakemaru" and "Wine Cellar Boy" have joined forces!!
m500434.ああ……立派に、育った、な……。: Ah…… you really have grown up.
m500434.あっちが同じ力を使ってくるわけだ。\nたぶん、こっちが使う以上に強力だけどなァ。:
That means they'll be using the same power against us.
It's probably even stronger than how we use it.
So protect it with your lives!
m500434.あてこそが、悪逆非道の鬼を討つべく、\n人と共に並び立つ――茨木童子、鬼刃姫だ！:
I am the one who will slay the wicked demons,
standing side by side with humanity—Ibaraki Doji, Kibahime!!
m500434.あては逃げも隠れもしないよ。\n悪鬼酒呑童子！\n善なる鬼、茨木童子が、その首も:
I don't run, and I don't hide.
Evil demon, Wine Cellar Boy!
The good demon, Ibaraki Doji, has come to take your head!!
m500434.いやいや、矜持で生きてるような鬼が、\nその矜持を捨てて、文字通り命懸けで挑んで:
No, no. These are demons who live by their pride.
They are throwing that pride away and coming at us with everything they have.
m500434.えぇ。東の国に一時の平穏が訪れても、\n別のどこかでは、争いの火種が生まれるもの:
Yes. Even if the Eastern Kingdom enjoys a moment of peace,
conflict is bound to brew somewhere else.
m500434.おいおい、笑えない冗談だなぁホムラ。\nあいつらが手を結ぶはずないだろ。\nプラ:
Hey, hey, that's no joke, Homura.
There's no way they'd team up.
They're both made of pure pride, you know?
m500434.おう、殺れるモンなら殺ってみやがれ茨木童子ィ。: Yeah, try and kill me if you can, Ibaraki Doji.
m500434.おうよ。\nその後は仲良く殺し合いでもしようや。\n鬼ってのは、そういうもんだか:
Agreed.
After that, we can have a friendly duel to the death.
That's just how demons are!
m500434.おぉ、馬鹿娘じゃねぇか。\nてっきり隠れて出てこねェかと思ってたぜ。:
Oh, you're a stupid girl, aren't you?
I was wondering if you'd stay hidden and never show up.
m500434.こっちが使っている間は心強そうですぽん。\n……で、ででで、でも、奪われちゃった:
It sounds reassuring while we're using it, pon.
...B-but, but, but, if it gets taken away from us—!
m500434.さぁて、あれがソハヤノツルギか。\n鬼狩りの魔剣とやら、鬼が振るえばどうなるか―:
So that's the Sohayano Tsurugi.
What will happen when a demon swings the demon hunter's cursed blade?
m500434.さぁ王子、凱旋だよ！\n胸を張って、王国に帰ろ！:
Come on, Prince. It's time for our victory parade!
Hold your head high and let's return to the kingdom!
m500434.されど、その鬼を討つ男が、この時代にいる。\nならば討たねばならん。\n鬼狩りの:
Yet, there is a man in this age who slays demons.
Then, we must slay him.
We must hunt human heads with the sword of the demon hunter.
m500434.そうだよ皆！\nあの鬼たちに苦しめられていた、\n東の国の人たちを助けられたんだ:
That's right, everyone!
We saved the people of the Eastern Kingdom
who had been suffering under those demons!
m500434.そして、ともに戦う仲間には、\nより強い力を与える、とも伝わっているわ。: And it is also said to grant greater power to those who fight alongside you.
m500434.その身に傷を負わせぬ、護法の剣か。\nそんなの持ってんなら、\nソハヤノツルギは:
A protective sword that prevents its wielder from being wounded?
If you have something like that,
do you even need the Sohayano Tsurugi?
m500434.その魔剣が、魔王決戦時の\n大規模な地割れから見つかってね。: That sword was discovered in a massive fissure that opened during the final battle with the Demon King.
m500434.それが残念なことに、事実なのよ……。: Unfortunately... that is exactly what has happened.
m500434.ど、どうなるんですかぽん！？\nさっきまであたし様たちのこと助けてくれてたのに！:
W-What are we going to do, pon!?
They were helping us just a moment ago!
m500434.なぜか分かるか、馬鹿娘の茨木童子。: Do you know why, you foolish Ibaraki Doji?
m500434.ふぅ……ようやく一段落だな。: Phew…… I think we can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
m500434.ほらほら、東の国のお酒にお料理にぃ～。: Come on, come on. The Eastern Kingdom's fine sake and cuisine, here we come~.
m500434.ぽこぽん？\nでも前に、王子さまたちは大嶽丸にも\n酒呑童子にも勝ったことがある:
Pokopon?
But didn't the Prince and his allies defeat both Otakemaru
and Wine Cellar Boy before, Pon?
m500434.カッ、そうかもしれねェ。\nだがその本質は違う。:
Ha, maybe you're right.
But that's not the real reason.
m500434.ククッ……然り……。\n互いに王子とは因縁のある身なれど、\n鬼同士が手を組むこ:
Kuk... Indeed...
Though we both have our own history with the Prince,
it was unthinkable for two demons to form an alliance.
m500434.ケッ……殺すつもりで来たくせに、\n何、泣きそうな顔……してやがる……。:
Tch... You came here to kill me,
and yet... why do you look like you're about to cry...?
m500434.ソハヤノツルギ……ははぁん、\n大嶽丸の野郎が、大昔に痛い目を見た魔剣だな？:
Sohayanotsurugi... I see.
That's the cursed blade that gave Otakemaru a nasty beating in the old days, isn't it?
m500434.ソハヤノツルギが人の手に渡れば、\n今度こそ、大嶽丸も酒呑童子も年貢の納め時って:
If Sohayanotsurugi falls into human hands,
this will finally be the end for both Otakemaru and Wine Cellar Boy.
m500434.ソハヤノツルギって言やぁ、\nその剣気の波動によって、体力自慢の相手ほど\n大き: The Sohayano Tsurugi is a cursed sword that inflicts greater damage on opponents with high stamina, thanks to its sword-qi waves.
m500434.人の手にあるならば鬼を討ち、\n鬼の手にあるならば国を崩す。\n正真正銘、本物の:
In human hands, it slays demons.
In a demon's hands, it brings a nation to ruin.
It is a genuine, bona fide cursed sword.
m500434.休んでいる暇はないと思うぞ？\n亜神に魔神に神獣に、この地を荒らす者は尽きる様子:
I don't think we have time to rest, though.
Sub-gods, great gods, divine beasts…… the threats ravaging this land show no sign of ending.
m500434.何しろ、名高い悪鬼、大嶽丸と酒呑童子を、\n同時に仕留めたってんだ。\nほら、叫:
After all, we just took down two of the most notorious demons,
Otakemaru and Wine Cellar Boy, at the same time.
Come on, let's yell! Let's drink! And while we're at it, let's dance!
m500434.同じことをやり返されるんだよ！\nあてたちの体力は削られるし、あいつらの力も強く:
They're going to do the same thing to us!
Our health will drain away, and their power will grow stronger!
m500434.地割れの先には、古代の祭殿が、\n当時の姿そのままに残されていたのよ。\nもちろ:
At the bottom of the fissure lay an ancient shrine hall,
preserved exactly as it was back then.
And, of course, Sohayanotsurugi was right there with it.
m500434.大丈夫、王子。\nあてが……終わらせてあげなくちゃ。:
Don't worry, Prince.
I... I have to put him out of his misery.
m500434.悪事を働いた代償だよ。: It's the price you pay for your wicked deeds.
m500434.悪巧みは終わったか？ 人間ども。\nならば行くぞ、我が剣――三明剣。:
Are you done with your scheming, humans?
Then let's go, my blade—Sanmeiken.
m500434.昔話じゃァよぉ、鬼はいつもやられてばかり、\n懲らしめられて泣いて謝る役柄だ。:
In the old tales, demons are always the ones who get beaten up,
humiliated, and forced to cry and apologize.
m500434.本気ってやつを、滅多に見せねェからだよ。\nさぁ、これこそが、大悪鬼酒呑童子サマ:
It's because they rarely show their true power.
Now then, witness the true might of the Great Evil Demon, Wine Cellar Boy!!
m500434.東の国の霊峰で、伝説の鬼狩りの魔剣、\n「ソハヤノツルギ」が見つかったのは知って: Did you hear that the legendary demon-slaying sword, "Sohayanotsurugi," has been found on a sacred peak in the eastern country?
m500434.此なるは、人が鬼を狩る剣に非ず。\n鬼がその暴威を解き放ち、\n国すら刈り取る魔:
This is no sword for humans to hunt demons.
It is a demonic blade that unleashes the demon's wrath,
a sword that can reap entire nations.
m500434.王子、あれがソハヤノツルギだよ。\n私たちが使えば心強い味方に、\n敵に奪われれ:
Prince, that is the Sohayano Tsurugi.
In our hands, it's a powerful ally,
but if the enemy takes it, it becomes a terrifying weapon.
m500434.王子、絶対に油断しちゃだめだよ。\n父上――うぅん、酒呑童子は、\nきっとこの戦:
Prince, you must not let your guard down for a moment.
Father――well, Wine Cellar Boy is surely
going to treat this battle as a fight for his life.
m500434.王子よ、我らが因縁に決着をつけよう。: Prince. Let us settle our grudge.
m500434.真面目だなァ、まったく。\nこういう時は酒でも飲んで馬鹿騒ぎするもんだぜ？:
You're all so serious. Honestly.
In times like this, you should be drinking and making a racket!
